instances.claim: This tells me that the value of the work is detached from the object and never settles — stated three times at the same altitude, with no new level of operation added on the second or third pass.
instances.why: Line 16 states the mechanism (value decoupled from object, held by consensus); 17 asserts the consequence in purely abstract terms ('indeterminate and continually redefined') and 18 asserts it again as process ('an ongoing process of redefinition'), sharing the root 'redefin-' with both 17 and line 15's 'continually redefined'. None of 17 or 18 moves to the object, the participant, or the form — those registers arrive separately in 19 and 20 — so the three lines occupy one register and one point. Keep 16 for the mechanism and 18 for the agency it gives Chang; 17 is the one that adds no level.
